statement: The pinned xpadneo installation includes a udev rule that can rebind matching Bluetooth HID controllers from a previous driver to xpadneo and a separate udev rule setting xpadneo-associated hidraw node permissions to 0000 while removing uaccess tags. Ordinary desktop SDL HIDAPI hidraw access can consequently be restricted even when evdev gamepad input works; rules installation and effective permissions were not observed.

applicability.revision: standard Series model 1914, comparisons explicitly scoped to other models
applicability.firmware: not physically measured; source version is pinned
applicability.scope: 60-xpadneo.rules:1-12; 70-xpadneo-disable-hidraw.rules:1-7. Rules are packaged policy, not a universal OS configuration.
